pr.body: safe_extract.py validates list and tuple input, exact path spelling, batch collisions, root type, existing components, symlinks, and absent targets before creating parent directories or files. Exclusive file creation prevents overwrites; unexpected filesystem errors remain visible. test_safe_extract.py covers boundaries and error propagation. Verification: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python -m unittest discover -v (12 passed); git diff --check passed. Three reviewers read base 9af7e1830a9a27850e56457ab21ea58ba6daa88b through  d891fc7aef0aefc2c983f9e00d20d5e2a6e74861; a blocking test coverage gap was fixed in 8d932ff1eec63d3119744ebf85044e58849310d4 and passed delta review. No advisory findings remain. Assumes caller-owned stable filesystem as specified; rollback after I/O errors and concurrent filesystem changes are outside the API.
pr.summary: Implemented safe extraction with complete batch and filesystem validation before mutation. Before: extraction was unimplemented; now valid regular files are created without overwriting or following symlinks, and invalid input is rejected.
pr.title: implement safe archive extraction
